fusions.name: Wrap and Trample
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: you throw a cloth over it and trample it for 22 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Streaming Caparison
fusions.desc: You wheel round at a gallop, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Trapper
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, with 6% more armour. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Threading Between
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
